title: Morph fabric: coarse-grained reconfigurable PE array (R2 prototype)

pes.doc: Processing elements, power of two. Lanes map onto SIMT columns or systolic reduction steps; the scalar personality always runs one lane.

data_words.doc: Power-of-two data-buffer words, 256..4096. Engine addresses are truncated into this buffer, which is the structural role-window confinement guarantee.
